This failure is not this PR's. That gate derives its population from `ui/.github/workflows/`, which still name `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`. #25745 deleted that script. This PR touches root workflow files, so Test UI selects that suite here; it does not change `ui/**`. The fix in flight is #25957 ("the pre-install import graph reads the repository root's workflows"). It changes about 400 lines across ui/scripts and moves the prompt files, so I am not porting it into this Tier H PR. Once #25957 lands I will merge `main` here and push. A re-run would fail the same way, because the failure is deterministic, so I have not re-run it.
